overclaims: No consistent, split-adjusted price series covers November 2022 through February 2026; the reported prices cannot establish the full-period trend.
checks.note: The excerpt, proposition, conditions, axis/horizon/outcome and citations are all accurate. The rationale's facts (an after-hours rise of up to 28% on 2023-05-24; an almost 5% daily gain and 50% YTD on 2025-10-28) match e1 and e2. The problem is the first limitation: it says no such price series covers the period, as if none exists. The packet only says one was not obtained. Suggested rewording: 'No consistent, split-adjusted price series for November 2022–February 2026 was obtained.'
